intro: Bahrain has less oil than its neighbours, so it built a banking and services economy.

chapters.title: Banking and aluminium
text: Bahrain was an early Gulf banking centre and is strong in Islamic finance. Its aluminium smelter, Alba, is one of the largest in the world.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Oil and gas still pay much of the government's budget; much of the oil comes from the offshore Abu Safah field, shared with Saudi Arabia.

keyTerms.meaning: Banking that follows Islamic rules, such as not charging interest.
